svg.title: w-01 POS order board (Business Web Portal, Staff view)
svg.desc: Low-fidelity wireframe of the POS order board at Café Mohnblume at 11:54 for Staff user Tobias Gruber: live status, pause and sold-out controls, three columns New, In preparation and Ready with tickets showing pickup slot, first name, lines with allergens, payment mode, accept countdown, delay and hand-over with pickup code and the paid-at-counter confirmation. Numbered callouts 1 to 11.

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
